title: Gaurav Kapadia - Everything Compounds - [Invest Like the Best, EP. 269]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Gaurav Kapadia, founder of investment firm XN.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Gaurav Kapadia, founder of investment firm XN. Gaurav is a veteran of the investing arena. We cover his lessons while rising to partner at TPG Axon, co-founding Soroban Capital, and his decision to launch XN in 2020.

key_points.text: We then discuss his approach to building XN around a culture of rigor and kindness, the importance of relationships in investing.
Please enjoy my great conversation with Gaurav Kapadia.
